providers.name: Vistra
providers.description: Vistra is a global corporate services provider operating in over 45 jurisdictions, offering entity management, incorporation, compliance, payroll, and fund administration services. The Vistra REST API enables developers to programmatically submit company incorporation requests in supported jurisdictions (initially British Virgin Islands), upload supporting documents to pre-signed storage URLs, and integrate Vistra's corporate services into business process workflows. Authentication uses OAuth2 bearer tokens obtained through the Vistra Developer Portal.

providers.name: KPMG
providers.description: KPMG is one of the Big Four professional services organizations, operating through a global network of independent member firms affiliated with KPMG International Limited, a private English company limited by guarantee that itself does not provide services to clients. The network spans more than 276,000 partners and employees across 138 countries and territories. KPMG organizes delivery across six service lines — Audit & Assurance, Tax, Legal, Advisory, ESG, and AI — and serves six industries: Consumer / Retail / Leisure; Energy, Natural Resources & Chemicals; Financial Services; Healthcare; Government & Public Sector; and Private Enterprise. AI is a first-class service line built on the KPMG Trusted AI framework — a ten-pillar approach covering Reliability, Security, Safety, Privacy, Sustainability, Explainability, Integrity, Transparency, Fairness, and Accountability — and packaged through five AI solutions: KPMG AI Jumpstart, AI Strategy, AI Trust, AI Workforce, and AI Technology. Alliances anchoring the AI delivery surface include Microsoft, Oracle, Salesforce, SAP, ServiceNow, and Workday, with collaboration noted with the World Economic Forum. KPMG Lakehouse, the firm's USD 450 million learning-and-innovation campus in Lake Nona, Orlando, is the cultural and AI-upskilling hub for the US firm and a venue for client innovation sessions in generative AI, ESG, and talent strategy. Insights is KPMG's research-publishing surface, organized across topic categories including AI and Technology, ESG, Operations, Risk and Regulation, Transformation, Value Creation, Workforce, Public Policy & Regulatory Change, Business Transformation, Audit & Assurance, Tax, Advisory, Sustainability, and Transactions, with flagship series such as the KPMG US Technology Survey Report, the KPMG Global Third-Party Risk Management Survey, the KPMG M&A Deal Market Study, Fit for Pillar Two, and AI Governance Principles for Boards. KPMG does not publish a public developer API or corporate developer portal at the network level; the firm has no enumerable public GitHub organization at `github.com/kpmg`. The one meaningful public API surface inside the KPMG brand is KPMG Origins (`kpmgorigins.com`) — an Australian regulated-waste tracking platform (initially the NSW Integrated Waste Tracking System / IWTS, with Queensland and other jurisdictions in scope) that exposes two REST APIs (Movements + Registries) over Swagger with API-key authentication, intended for integration with waste-operator software rather than as a general-purpose KPMG developer surface. Distribution to readers and client stakeholders flows through the Insights site, the US Subscription Center (Opportunity (In)sight monthly newsletter), KPMG Australia's Business Insights podcast, and per-page RSS feeds offered on individual KPMG member-firm pages.

providers.name: Deloitte
providers.description: Deloitte is one of the Big Four professional services organizations, operating through a network of member firms coordinated by Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited (DTTL). The organization spans approximately 150 countries and territories, has more than 180 years of history (founded 1845), and serves roughly 90% of the Fortune Global 500. Deloitte organizes delivery across four primary service lines — Audit & Assurance, Consulting, Tax, and Legal — plus specialized cross-functional practices including Business Process Solutions and Global Employer Services. Consulting offerings cover Customer, Cyber, Engineering / AI & Data, Enterprise Technology & Performance, Finance Transformation, Human Capital, Strategy & Transactions, and Risk / Regulatory & Forensic. Deloitte Digital is the technology-and-experience practice with alliances spanning Salesforce, Adobe, SAP, Google Cloud, AWS, ServiceNow, Oracle, Shopify, Sitecore, and Genesys, and accelerators such as FrontOffice Advantage, Revenue Advantage, Agentic Marketing Cloud, CreativEdge, Blueprint, Content Studios, and TrustID. The organization serves six industries divided into twenty sectors: Consumer; Energy, Resources & Industrials; Financial Services; Government & Public Services; Life Sciences & Health Care; and Technology, Media & Telecommunications. Deloitte Insights is the organization's research-publishing surface, organized into eight research centers — Cross-Industry, Economics, Consumer, Energy & Industrials, Financial Services, Government & Public Services, Life Sciences & Health Care, and Tech, Media & Telecom — producing flagship series including Tech Trends, Global Human Capital Trends, Digital Media Trends, TMT Predictions, FSI Predictions, the Weekly Global Economic Outlook, and the annual Industry Outlooks. The Deloitte AI Institute drives applied-AI research and points of view. Deloitte does not publish a public developer API or open developer portal at the corporate level. The Deloitte US Consulting GitHub organization is small (5 visible repositories, mostly archived upstream forks; the original artifact is `beacon`, a first-party web-analytics packaging library in TypeScript). Reader-facing distribution flows through MyDeloitte (personalized content + newsletter subscriptions), Dbriefs (live webcasts with CPE credit), the Deloitte Insights Magazine, and the YouTube channel; no public RSS index page was discoverable on www.deloitte.com at the path published in legacy archives.

providers.name: Cognizant Technology Solutions
providers.description: Cognizant Technology Solutions is a multinational information technology services and consulting company that provides digital, technology, consulting, and operations services to clients worldwide. Cognizant does not publish a general-purpose public REST API. Its developer-facing footprint is centered on the Cognizant Neuro AI platform family (Neuro AI Decisioning, Neuro AI Enterprise Core, Neuro AI Engineering, Neuro AI for IT Operations) and the open-source Neuro SAN multi-agent orchestration framework released by Cognizant AI Lab. Other delivered platforms (BigFrame for mainframe data migration, ADM accelerators, industry vertical solutions) are typically engaged via consulting engagements rather than self-service APIs.

Concentrix does not publish a public developer API; the iX product suite and Catalyst services are delivered via managed engagements and enterprise integrations rather than a self-service developer portal.
